findings.finding: The frozen OOC flow creates the 5 ns clock but leaves HD.CLK_SRC and all I/O delays unset, producing Timing 38-242 and 1000 TIMING-18 warnings. Therefore its raw WNS=2.158 ns is not sufficient by itself as a reusable integration timing claim.
findings.independent_resolution: A verifier-only audit of the exact fresh DCP added HD.CLK_SRC, 0.5 ns max/0.0 ns min I/O delays and hold-only false paths on external ports. WNS=1.865 ns, WHS=0.088 ns, WPWS=1.800 ns, methodology=0 and DRC=0; all 2476 internal hold endpoints remained timed.
findings.promotion_effect: non_blocking_for_control_integration; real integration constraints must replace the audit assumptions

findings.finding: Vivado Synth 8-6013 identifies the 64Kx128 UltraRAM as a 2-column by 8-row cascade with one absorbed pipeline stage versus three recommended.
findings.evidence: The exact synthesized OOC netlist still meets 5 ns timing, but no placed or routed result exists.
findings.promotion_effect: non_blocking_for_control_integration; must be revisited during placed/routed integration

limitations: This promotes only the reusable bank_subsystem integration packet.
No dispatcher, DataMover adapter, DMA payload path, GEMM/systolic arithmetic, AXI/PS wrapper, board implementation, bitstream or physical-board behavior is claimed.
OOC is synthesized, not placed or routed; real integration and board timing remain mandatory.
One-cycle acquire/release transaction pulses remain an upstream integration obligation.
The verifier-only timing context is an audit assumption and is not a modification of the frozen implementation flow.
